description.text: The first reprint set, released only in English on 24 February 2000: 130 cards from Base Set and Jungle, with a Poké Ball and a 2 as its set symbol. As a set of reprints it had no 1st Edition print, and it was the first English set with cosmos holofoil, where Base Set, Jungle and Fossil used galaxy foil. Fans waiting for new cards gave it a cool reception; Team Rocket followed two months later.
